entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who appears as the Planeswalker card of one of the two Theros Beyond Death Planeswalker decks, as Elspeth, Undaunted Hero.

entities.name: Ashiok

entities.name: Daxos

entities.name: Taranika

entities.name: Tymaret

entities.name: Karametra
